Welcome to Legacy of Legends, our real-life animal rescue and sanctuary based at The Magical Moon Farm in rural France 🌿

Here, once-forgotten horses, donkeys, and other animals find safety, kindness, and a second chance at life. We care for retired elite sport horses, elderly equines, and endangered Poitou donkeys — giving them the dignity, comfort, and love they deserve.

Every video shares a true story: from the rescue of an elderly horse to the first steps of a tiny newborn donkey. We believe every life matters, and every legend deserves a beautiful ending 🌙💫

Join our worldwide family of animal lovers, follow the daily lives of our rescued souls, and be part of something magical — a place where hope and compassion truly live.

🩶 Subscribe to follow their journeys and help us continue our mission of rescue, rehabilitation, and love.
